integrity: Proof uses standard projective-module, finite p-group locality, and polynomial trace lemmas; finite checks corroborate examples but not the universal statement; publication priority provisional because a broader 1985 K0 source is unavailable.
scientific_limitations: Requires connected commutative base, finite modular p-group action and a stable maximal ideal with trivial residue action; excludes twisted crossed products and arbitrary non-modular groups; no projective-class classification.
title: Fixed-residue rank congruence for modular skew group algebras
